```{r libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(deeptime)

# Technology palette for facet strips
technology_palette <- c(
  "ONT dRNA" = "#56B4E9",  # Soft Blue
  "ONT cDNA" = "#4A5899",  # Sandy gold
  "Iso-Seq"   = "#EE7B30",  # Old PacBio color
  "Kinnex"   = "#e31c93"   # PacBio pink
)

lab_text_palette <- c(
  "ONT dRNA" = "#FFFFFF",  # Soft Blue
  "ONT cDNA" = "#FFFFFF",  # Deep Blue
  "Iso-Seq"   = "#FFFFFF",  # Soft Orange
  "Kinnex"   = "#FFFFFF",   # Vermilion/Orange-Red
  "Bambu" = "#000000",
  "FLAIR" = "#000000",
  "IsoQuant" =  "#000000",
  "Kallisto" = "#000000",
  "Oarfish" = "#000000"
)

# Standard normalization color palette matching the main figure
color_palette <- c(
  "CPM" = "#767676",  # Neutral mid grey
  "TPM" = "#33B5A5",  # Professional teal
  "cqn" = "#B64342",  # Publication red
  "EDA" = "#E28E2C",  # Soft gold/orange
  "ratio_counts" = "#7570B3" # Muted purple
)

# Nature theme
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 6.5, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.7),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3, face = "bold"),
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = 5.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 2, r = 2, b = 2, l = 2)),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

theme_set(theme_nature())
```

```{r load_data}
read_dataset <- function(manifest_file, dataset){
  input_files <- read.delim(manifest_file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  l_files <- list()
  for (i in 1:nrow(input_files)){
    input_path <- input_files[i,1]
    technology <- input_files[i,2]
    df <- read.csv(input_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df$dataset <- dataset
    df$technology <- gsub("_", " ", technology) # Replace technical underscores with clean spaces
    l_files[[input_path]] <- df
  }
  all_data <- do.call(rbind, l_files)
  return(all_data)
}

datasets <- c("NIH", "Neuron", "LongBench")
l_data <- list()
for (dataset in datasets){
  manifest_file <- paste0("data/length_", dataset, ".fofn")
  l_data[[dataset]] <- read_dataset(manifest_file, dataset)
}
all_data <- do.call(rbind, l_data)
all_data$dataset[all_data$dataset == "NIH"] <- "Mouse"
all_data$dataset[all_data$dataset == "Neuron"] <- "iNeuron"

# Update datasets for plotting
datasets <- c("Mouse", "LongBench", "iNeuron")

# Pick one condition per dataset (same as Figure 3, fig2.Rmd)
all_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(Condition %in% c("Brain", "SCLC_A", "isoB11"))
```

```{r compute_cv}
# Calculate Coefficient of Variation (CV) of mean_exp across length bins
cv_results <- all_data %>%
  group_by(dataset, technology, Tool, Normalization) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_expression = mean(mean_exp, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_expression = sd(mean_exp, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv = sd_expression / mean_expression,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Order factors for plotting
cv_results <- cv_results %>%
  mutate(
    Tool = case_when(
      Tool == "flair"    ~ "FLAIR",
      Tool == "isoquant" ~ "IsoQuant",
      Tool == "kallisto" ~ "Kallisto",
      Tool == "oarfish"  ~ "Oarfish",
      Tool == "bambu"    ~ "Bambu",
      TRUE               ~ as.character(Tool)
    )
  )
cv_results$Tool <- factor(cv_results$Tool, levels = c("Bambu", "FLAIR", "IsoQuant", "Kallisto", "Oarfish"))
cv_results$Normalization <- factor(cv_results$Normalization, levels = c("CPM", "TPM", "cqn", "EDA", "ratio_counts"))
```

```{r generate_plots}
l_plots <- list()

# Generate plots per dataset using facet_grid_color to show technologies (rows) and tools (columns)
for (my_dataset in datasets){
  l_plots[[my_dataset]] <- cv_results %>%
    filter(dataset == my_dataset) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Normalization, y = cv, fill = Normalization)) +

    # Use clean bar plots to represent the CV magnitude per normalization
    geom_col(width = 0.75, color = "black", linewidth = 0.15) +

    # Grid of technology (rows) and tool (columns) matching Fig 3
    facet_grid_color(technology ~ Tool, scales = "free_y", colors = technology_palette, lab_colors = lab_text_palette) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = color_palette,
      guide = "none",
      labels = c("CPM" = "CPM", "TPM" = "TPM", "cqn" = "CQN", "EDA" = "EDASeq", "ratio_counts" = "SMR")
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("CPM" = "CPM", "TPM" = "TPM", "cqn" = "CQN", "EDA" = "EDASeq", "ratio_counts" = "SMR")) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Length Bins Expression CV",
      title = my_dataset
    ) +
    theme_nature() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}
```

```{r assemble}
# Assemble vertically with patchwork
cv_fig <- l_plots$Mouse / l_plots$LongBench / l_plots$iNeuron +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r export}
# Export function
save_pub_r <- function(plot, filename, width_mm = 180, height_mm = 220, dpi = 600) {
  w <- width_mm / 25.4
  h <- height_mm / 25.4

  # Lossless Vector SVG
  svglite::svglite(paste0(filename, ".svg"), width = w, height = h)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  # Vector PDF with embedded fonts
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(paste0(filename, ".pdf"), width = w, height = h, family = "sans")
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  # High-DPI TIFF for publication print
  ragg::agg_tiff(paste0(filename, ".tiff"), width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = dpi)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  # PNG for rapid preview
  ggsave(paste0(filename, ".png"), plot, width = w, height = h, dpi = 150)
}

# Save plots in the plots directory
save_pub_r(cv_fig, "plots/Supplementary_Figure_7", height_mm = 220, width_mm = 160)
```

```{r platform_summary}
# Calculate platform-level summaries (the values written in the paper)
platform_cv_summary <- cv_results %>%
  mutate(platform_type = if_else(grepl("ONT", technology), "ONT (cDNA and dRNA combined)", "PacBio (Iso-Seq and Kinnex combined)")) %>%
  group_by(platform_type, Normalization) %>%
  summarize(
    Mean_CV = mean(cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_CV = median(cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Save summary tables to the plots directory
dir.create("plots", showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(platform_cv_summary, "plots/length_bias_platform_cv_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cv_results, "plots/length_bias_cv_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

print(as.data.frame(platform_cv_summary))
```

```{r source_data}
source("../source_data_utils.R")

# CV of the mean normalized expression across length bins
supp7_source <- cv_results %>%
  transmute(Dataset = dataset, Platform = technology, Tool,
            Normalization = relabel_norm(Normalization),
            `Mean across length bins` = mean_expression,
            `SD across length bins` = sd_expression, CV = cv)
supp7_sheets <- split_panels(supp7_source, c(`Supp Fig 7a` = "Mouse", `Supp Fig 7b` = "LongBench",
                                             `Supp Fig 7c` = "iNeuron"))
supp7_sheets$`Platform CV summary` <- platform_cv_summary %>%
  transmute(Platform = platform_type, Normalization = relabel_norm(Normalization),
            `Mean CV` = Mean_CV, `Median CV` = Median_CV)
write_source_data(supp7_sheets, "Supplementary_Figure_7")
```
